prompts.gate: Use case: illustration-story. Single landscape 1536x1024 cinematic Chinese classical xianxia digital painting, highly polished restrained brush textures. Tight environment detail at Xuanxiao sect mountain gate at rainy night: wet ancient bluestone steps and one weathered stone boundary marker with fresh narrow water streak across its face. Cropped eye-level downward view from outside the boundary. Dark mountain mist in soft background, cold reflected rain light. No glowing magic currently. No humans, hands, bodies, silhouettes, weapons, lanterns, paper, book, modern items, text, lettering or watermark. Do not depict gate doors or invent exits. This is a reusable close environmental insert, not an empty establishing shot of an entire populated scene.
